knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

## Load raw data
```{r}
gini_raw <- read.csv("data/UNGini.csv")
```

```{r}
# Clean Gini Index data
gini_clean <- gini_raw %>%
  
  # 1. Remove non-country rows such as regions, world totals, and income groups
  filter(
    !str_detect(
      Country.or.Area,
      "region|Region|World|WORLD|income|Income|developed|Developed"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Keep only rows where Year is numeric
  filter(str_detect(Year, "^\\d+$")) %>%
  
  # 3. Convert Year to integer
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year)) %>%
  
  # 4. Keep only the columns we actually need
  select(
    Country = Country.or.Area,
    Year,
    Gini = Value
  ) %>%
  
  # 5. Remove missing Gini values
  filter(!is.na(Gini)) %>%
  
  # 6. Keep only realistic Gini values (0–100)
  filter(Gini >= 0 & Gini <= 100)

```


##preview
```{r}
glimpse(gini_clean)

```


##save
```{r}
write.csv(gini_clean, "data/UNGini_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
